content:
---POSSIBLE FIX COMMITS---

---RECENT SAM/VFC DIFFS---
34ba6c72 Add sam_format_aux1 and bam_aux_get_str APIs. (PR #1134)
3ac8a04f Sped up bcf_check_record.
f4f7f249 Improvement (personal preference) to previous C99 fix.
78648e2a Bug fix to the pileup constructor.
adeeb887 Add bcf_ prefix to variant_t struct
71b9e4ff Rename public HTSlib struct tags to omit leading underscores
4162046b Tidy bcf_hdr_subset() error handling
260c5a35 Improve bcf_hdr_format error checking.
6e759d37 Improved return from bcf_hdr_parse_line to enable error detection.
3855184b More mem-checking & threading hardening (write side).
8ae25df4 More protection against running out of memory (all formats read side).
773b6ed3 Fixed deadlocks and crashes in threaded SAM parsing.
0e8a6e21 Fix bug in the line reallocation for threaded SAM decoding.
a79009b3 Don't trash errno in bam_tag2cigar.
a2fdf3b2 Consider alignments which consume no reference bases to have length 1
dcd4b730 Fix check for VCF record size
df31e599 Avoid crash for `bcf_update_alleles(hdr, rec, NULL, 0)`
2c49d191 Don't call exit(1) on invalid INFO numbers in vcf_format()
6fc307b7 Catch invalid dictionary indexes in vcf_format()
1d6b6826 Better catch BCF CHROM/FILTER/FORMAT ids absent from the header
82d01ba6 Implement vcf_open_mode method (PR #1096)
29d06c2f Improve bam_aux_update_str() (#1088)
33bfcfa3 Fix mpileup regression between 1.9 and 1.10.
9de45b72 Further speed up of VCF parser (formats).
b1acab62 Implement and use the `hts_str2dbl` method (by @jkbonfield)
6d7da635 Speed up GT parsing
9c4c64d8 Extract functionality from `vcf_parse` into individual parsing methods.
4a783b84 Use hts_str2int, instead of strtol, in the VCF parser.
e3cdb1df Use the new hts_strprint() instead of dump_char()
3a73df58 Improve SAM parser unrecognised RNAME warnings
